en: Changed `allowedMcpServers` to stop filtering `managed-mcp.json` stdio servers that use `${VAR}` only in `env`: one your allowlist left out now loads on upgrade; use `deniedMcpServers` to keep it off
zh: 变更 `allowedMcpServers`，不再过滤仅在 `env` 中使用 `${VAR}` 的 `managed-mcp.json` stdio 服务器：升级后，被允许列表排除的服务器会加载；如需保持禁用，请使用 `deniedMcpServers`
